summary: Guardforce AI Co., Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notification granting an additional 180-day period, until December 7, 2026, to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement. No specific share price, premium, or transaction terms are disclosed. The filing is a routine regulatory update regarding continued listing standards and does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. The company may consider a reverse share split if needed, but no definitive action is announced.
